hero.title: A design system that can ship a fleet product.
hero.lede: Design System now works as a documentation product: foundations, primitives, components, patterns, templates, stack decisions, and agent-readable specifications connected through real product flows.

coverage.title: Coverage is broad. Depth is uneven.
coverage.copy: This is the current working map: some layers are structurally updated, while components, patterns, and templates still need richer product examples and interactions.

items.label: Components
items.reference: Button gold, Select interactive, group standard for the rest

items.label: Patterns
items.reference: Pattern playbook applied, examples still need richer flows

items.label: Templates
items.reference: Domain templates exist, screen systems need sharper differentiation

documentationStatus.title: Batch the work, then promote the winners to gold.
documentationStatus.copy: We should not move one page at a time forever. The fast path is fixing shared templates first, then promoting high-impact artifacts into hand-authored examples.

items.detail: Role groups, architecture, visual explanation, contract, spec, agent prompt.
Overview, live-style demo, responsibilities, token chain, API, spec, agent prompt.
Button is gold. Select now has interactive examples. Remaining components inherit family standards and need richer live demos by group.
Decision trees, failure modes, journeys, metrics, research, contracts. Needs more product-specific screens per pattern family.
They exist as domain templates, but need stronger screen systems, dashboard layouts, mobile route/card flows, and configuration flows.

visualMigration.title: Use the ZIP as a benchmark, not a new source of truth.
visualMigration.copy: The next phase is to match the ZIP's product polish through Design System's existing foundations, primitives, contracts, and audit gates.

items.label: Migration rule
items.detail: Design System foundations and primitives stay in charge: Energy, Voice, Frame, Depth, Momentum, State, Density, Charts, Maps, and Accessibility.

items.label: Migration rule
items.detail: Use the ZIP as a benchmark for polish, mobility examples, product screens, state richness, and interaction rhythm.

items.label: Migration rule
items.detail: Do not import raw color, typography, public size props, inline styles, hand-written charts, or direct map assumptions.

items.label: Start small
items.detail: Button and Select prove the benchmark quality first, then Card, Icon Button, Badge, Chip, Field, and Input.

architecture.title: Nothing skips a layer.
architecture.copy: Every route, dashboard, card action, and permission system traces through the same inheritance model.
